pairs.target: chēshàng xiān xiàlái de shì shī nán , wàiyī xiàbǎi zhān le ní , yì shǒutíxiāng , yì shǒufú zhù chēmén .
pairs.english: Shinan got off first, mud on his coat hem, carrying a case in one hand and holding the cart door with the other.
pairs.hanzi: 车上先下来的是施南，外衣下摆沾了泥，一手提箱，一手扶住车门。

pairs.target: yīwén gēn zài hòumiàn , huáilǐ bào zhe yíjuàn bùkěn fútiē de zhǐ , jiǎo gāng luòdì , zhǐjuàn biàn zài shǒubì jiān wǎng wài bèng le yíxià .
pairs.english: Iven followed with a stubborn paper roll in his arms; just as his feet touched ground, it sprang outward between his elbows.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文跟在后面，怀里抱着一卷不肯服帖的纸，脚刚落地，纸卷便在手臂间往外蹦了一下。

pairs.target: tā yòng xiàbā yāzhù , tái yǎn kànjiàn tǎ wéi , xiào hái méi chūlái , xiān wèn shuǐ zài nǎér .
pairs.english: He held it with his chin, looked up at Tavi and, before even smiling, first asked where the water was.
pairs.hanzi: 他用下巴压住，抬眼看见塔维，笑还没出来，先问水在哪儿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zìjǐ gāng fàngxià de shuǐhú qǔ lái , yīwén hēwán cái tóng tā pèng le yíxià jiān .
pairs.english: Tavi fetched the flask he had just put down. After drinking, Iven bumped shoulders with him.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将自己刚放下的水壶取来，伊文喝完才同他碰了一下肩。

pairs.target: shī nán yǐjīng cháo jiē fáng zǒu , jiào yīwén jiānglái shí gèzhàn de shōutiáo xiān qǔchū lái , búyào bǎ zìjǐ de diǎnxīn tóng jiāojiē běn juàn zài yíchù .
pairs.english: Shinan was already heading for the receiving office, telling Iven to get the receipts from their journey's stations out first, rather than roll his snacks into the handover book.
pairs.hanzi: 施南已经朝接房走，叫伊文将来时各站的收条先取出来，不要把自己的点心同交接本卷在一处。

pairs.target: tā gǎnjǐn yìngshēng , gěi tǎ wéi kàn le yìyǎn kōng zhe de shǒu , yìsī shì jīnwǎn zàishuō .
pairs.english: He answered quickly and showed Tavi his empty hand: talk tonight.
pairs.hanzi: 他赶紧应声，给塔维看了一眼空着的手，意思是今晚再说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái xiǎng dài tā xiān qù kàn gāojià , zuǐbiān nà jù yǐjīng gǔn dào yíbàn , zhǐhǎo gǎichéng kǎobǐng pù zài jiē hòu .
pairs.english: Tavi had wanted to show him the towers first; the sentence was half out before he changed it to say the bakery was behind the street.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来想带他先去看高架，嘴边那句已经滚到一半，只好改成烤饼铺在街后。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō dù chéng gāng zhǐ guò , zìjǐ mòshōu dào nà zhāng dàbǐng tú , xìnghǎo yígè zhènshàng hái méi duōchū èrshíjiā kǎobǐng pù .
pairs.english: Iven said Du Cheng had just pointed it out. He had not received the giant-flatbread drawing, fortunately the town had not acquired twenty bakeries yet.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说杜澄刚指过，自己没收到那张大饼图，幸好一个镇上还没多出二十家烤饼铺。

pairs.target: tā gēnzhe shī nán jìnwū , huíshēn yòu jiào tǎ wéi bié wèi děng zìjǐ bù chīfàn , ruò wǎnxiē biàn dào huìguǎn zhǎo tā .
pairs.english: He followed Shinan indoors, turning to tell Tavi not to miss dinner waiting for him; later he could find him at the guest lodge.
pairs.hanzi: 他跟着施南进屋，回身又叫塔维别为等自己不吃饭，若晚些便到会馆找他。

pairs.target: jiē fáng de mén bìng méi guān , kě nà yíduànhuà búshì gěi tǎ wéi liú de .
pairs.english: The office door was not closed, but that conversation had not been left for Tavi.
pairs.hanzi: 接房的门并没关，可那一段话不是给塔维留的。

pairs.target: tā zài ménkǒu zhàn le yíhuìer , jiàn yīwén yǐ tānkāi běnzi , tí bǐjì shī nán tóng dù chéng duì de zhànmíng , cái huídào gōngpéng .
pairs.english: He stood at the door awhile, saw Iven open his book and record the station names Shinan was checking with Du Cheng, then returned to the workshop.
pairs.hanzi: 他在门口站了一会儿，见伊文已摊开本子，提笔记施南同杜澄对的站名，才回到工棚。

pairs.target: wēn xiù zhèng děng tā ná yàng kuàng , bǐ yǔ hòu chóngxīn chá guò de xiè guǐ liǎngduān , wèn tā shìbushì péngyǒu dào le , lián zìjǐ de zì yě gēnzhe pǎochūqù .
pairs.english: Wenxiu was waiting for his gauge frame to compare both ends of the rails rechecked after rain. She asked whether his friend's arrival had sent his own writing running outside too.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫正等他拿样框，比雨后重新查过的卸轨两端，问他是不是朋友到了，连自己的字也跟着跑出去。

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn , guǒrán jiāng yíchù huàn guò de zhànwèi chāo dào jiù lán lǐ , biàn huàdiào zhòngxiě . zhècì méi bǎ yīwén jiào lái yìqǐ kàn , xiān jiāng zìjǐ zhè bàn bān de shì zuò wán .
pairs.english: He looked down: sure enough, he had copied an altered position into the old column, so crossed it out and rewrote it. This time he did not call Iven over, finishing his own half shift first.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头看，果然将一处换过的站位抄到旧栏里，便划掉重写。这次没把伊文叫来一起看，先将自己这半班的事做完。

pairs.target: chuāngwài liǎnggè rén zhèngzài shì tuī kōng jià , tíngxiàlái hé shǒushì shí , tā cái hūrán xiào le yíxià : yīwén yuánlái búshì shuō zhe hǎowán , zhēn huì gēnzhe biérén diǎnmíng le .
pairs.english: Outside, two people were practicing with an empty cradle. As they stopped to check signals, he suddenly smiled: Iven had not been joking, he really could take attendance with others now.
pairs.hanzi: 窗外两个人正在试推空架，停下来核手势时，他才忽然笑了一下：伊文原来不是说着好玩，真会跟着别人点名了。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn , yīwén dào kǎobǐng pù zhǎo tā , jiānshàng de zhǐjuàn yǐjīng huànchéng yígè bú dà de bùdài .
pairs.english: At dusk Iven found him at the bakery, the paper roll replaced by a small cloth bag on his shoulder.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚，伊文到烤饼铺找他，肩上的纸卷已经换成一个不大的布袋。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn shìbushì zhōngyú zhī shèng diǎnxīn , tā cóng lǐtou mō chū yìběn báo cè , shuō bùqiǎo , háiyǒu míngzǎo yào kàn de , liǎng rén dōu tàn le yìkǒuqì , tàn wán yòu xiào .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if only snacks remained at last. He took out a thin booklet: unfortunately, something for tomorrow morning too. Both sighed, then laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问是不是终于只剩点心，他从里头摸出一本薄册，说不巧，还有明早要看的，两人都叹了一口气，叹完又笑。

pairs.target: tāmen méi lìkè tán gōngshì . yīwén xiān shuō huìguǎn de chuáng duǎn , jiǎo ruò fàng zhí , biàn xiàng tì ménwài de rén liú lùbiāo ;
pairs.english: They did not discuss work immediately. Iven first complained the lodge bed was short: stretching his feet would leave signposts for people outside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 他们没立刻谈公事。伊文先说会馆的床短，脚若放直，便像替门外的人留路标；

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bú xìn , jiào tā bǐyibǐ , cái fāxiàn duìfāng zhèzhènzǐ sìhū yòu gāo le yìdiǎn , huòzhě shì zìjǐ zǒngzhàn zài gāojià xià , bǎ jiàn guò de rén dōu jì xiǎo le .
pairs.english: Tavi did not believe him and asked for a comparison, then noticed he seemed taller lately. Or perhaps standing beneath towers had made everyone in his memory smaller.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不信，叫他比一比，才发现对方这阵子似乎又高了一点，或者是自己总站在高架下，把见过的人都记小了。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō bié ná mùcè xiě jìn juànzōng , zìjǐ xīn cái de kùzǐ dǎo shì zhēnde duǎn le bànjié . huà shuō dào zhèlǐ , tā jiāng bùdài fàngzài zhuōxià , zhōngyú xiàng cóng jiē fánglǐ xièxià yíjiàn dōngxī , zuò dé yě méi gāngcái nàme zhí .
pairs.english: Iven said not to enter visual estimates in the files, though his newly tailored trousers really were too short. He put the bag under the table, finally as though unloading something from the receiving office, and sat less stiffly.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说别拿目测写进卷宗，自己新裁的裤子倒是真的短了半截。话说到这里，他将布袋放在桌下，终于像从接房里卸下一件东西，坐得也没刚才那么直。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gěi tā jiǎng hóngqí hé shí bèi de huí xiāng , jiǎng nài lěi nà fēng hái méi dìng xiàlái de yāoqǐng , yě jiǎng zìjǐ jīnrì zhī zuò guò yícì jiēchù liànxí .
pairs.english: Tavi told him about the red flag, Shibei's return crates, Nerai's unsettled invitation and his single contact practice today.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维给他讲红旗和石背的回箱，讲奈蕾那封还没定下来的邀请，也讲自己今日只做过一次接触练习。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu bǎ yìzǎo kànqīng liǎnggēn zhǐzhēn de nà yìdiǎn gāoxìng cáng qǐlái , yīwén rènzhēn tīng wán , shēnshǒu zài zhuōshàng bǐ le liǎnggè bùtóng de gāodù , shuō nà zìjǐ yǐhòu kě bùnéng ná yìgēn shǒuzhǐ dāng liǎnggēn .
pairs.english: He did not hide his delight at understanding the two pointers that morning. Iven listened carefully, marked two different heights on the table and said he must never count one finger as two again.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有把一早看清两根指针的那一点高兴藏起来，伊文认真听完，伸手在桌上比了两个不同的高度，说那自己以后可不能拿一根手指当两根。

pairs.target: " nǐ xiān bǎ yìgēn yòng míngbái . " tǎ wéi shuō . yīwén hěn shòushāng shìde jiāng shǒu shōuhuí , duān qǐ wǎn , jiào tā bié gāng duō huì yíxiàng biàn shōu xuéfèi .
pairs.english: “Learn to use one first,” Tavi said. Looking deeply wounded, Iven withdrew his hand, picked up his bowl and told him not to charge tuition after learning one more thing.
pairs.hanzi:
“你先把一根用明白。”塔维说。
伊文很受伤似的将手收回，端起碗，叫他别刚多会一项便收学费。

pairs.target: diànlǐ de rén sònglái rè bǐng , liǎng rén yi rén bāi yìbiān , shuí yě méi xiān wèn shìbushì yíyàng dà , yīwén nàbiān piān duōyìdiǎn , tā biàndāng méi kànjiàn .
pairs.english: Hot flatbread arrived; each broke off a side, neither asking first whether they matched. Iven's was slightly larger, and he pretended not to notice.
pairs.hanzi: 店里的人送来热饼，两人一人掰一边，谁也没先问是不是一样大，伊文那边偏多一点，他便当没看见。

pairs.target: chī dào yíbàn , tǎ wéi cái wèn zhè tàng jiūjìng kàn shénme .
pairs.english: Halfway through eating, Tavi asked what precisely this trip examined.
pairs.hanzi: 吃到一半，塔维才问这趟究竟看什么。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō jǐduàn lù zhuǎnjiāo de zìjù bù yízhì , yǒudeshì zhàng , yǒudeshì shōujiàn , háiyǒu zhècì shǎo le xiànzhì de jiǎn tiáo , tāmen yuánběn biàn yào zhú zhàn duì .
pairs.english: Iven said wording passed between road sections differed: accounts, receipts and now the brief missing restrictions. They had already planned station-by-station comparison.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说几段路转交的字句不一致，有的是账，有的是收件，还有这次少了限制的简条，他们原本便要逐站对。

pairs.target: jīnrì jiàndào dù chéng de yuánjiàn , cái zhīdào zhuǎnchāo de yìzhāng quèshí dào le chēfū shǒushàng , bù zhǐshì zài zhǐ shàng yǒu liǎngzhǒng xiěfǎ .
pairs.english: Seeing Du Cheng's original today showed that the copy really had reached a driver, rather than merely existing as two paper versions.
pairs.hanzi: 今日见到杜澄的原件，才知道转抄的一张确实到了车夫手上，不只是在纸上有两种写法。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jiāng shī nán wèi gěi rén kàn de cèzǐ ná chūlái , zhī bǎ zìjǐ de chāishì shuō qīng : xiān bǎ nǎ zhàn shōudào nǎ yìzhāng lièmíng , bùnéng jiàndào jiālǐ shúrén de míngzì , biàn tì nà yìháng tiān yíjù zìjǐ zhīdào tārén búcuò .
pairs.english: He did not produce Shinan's unshared books, only explained his job: list which station received which sheet first, without adding “I know he's decent” beside a family acquaintance's name.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有将施南未给人看的册子拿出来，只把自己的差事说清：先把哪站收到哪一张列明，不能见到家里熟人的名字，便替那一行添一句自己知道他人不错。

pairs.target: yě bùnéng wèile zhèngmíng zìjǐ búkào jiālǐ , fǎndǎo xiān ná nà rén dāng cuò de .
pairs.english: Nor could he assume the person was wrong first just to prove independence from his family.
pairs.hanzi: 也不能为了证明自己不靠家里，反倒先拿那人当错的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng chū tā zài shuō cóngqián nà dùnfàn , què méi wèn shìbushì fùqīn yòu mà tā .
pairs.english: Tavi heard the earlier meal in those words, but did not ask whether his father had scolded him again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听出他在说从前那顿饭，却没问是不是父亲又骂他。

pairs.target: yīwén de sháozǐ tíng zài wǎn biān , guò le yíhuìer , zìjǐ xiān shuō lùshang yǒurén tīngjiàn xìng , biàn wèn tā fùqīn jìnlái guǎn buguǎn zhèbiān de shì .
pairs.english: Iven's spoon paused at his bowl. After a while he volunteered that someone on the road had heard his surname and asked whether his father currently handled affairs here.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文的勺子停在碗边，过了一会儿，自己先说路上有人听见姓，便问他父亲近来管不管这边的事。

pairs.target: zìjǐ zhǐnéng huídá zài zhèlǐ gēn shī nán zuò shénme , bùnéng jiāng méi tóng fùqīn wèn guò dehuà yě dàngzuò fùqīn shuō le .
pairs.english: He could only answer what he was doing with Shinan here, not treat words he had never checked with his father as his father's own.
pairs.hanzi: 自己只能回答在这里跟施南做什么，不能将没同父亲问过的话也当作父亲说了。

pairs.target: lóuxià yǒurén shōuqǐ ménbǎn , shēngyīn hěn xiǎng , yīwén shùnzhe kàn le yìyǎn , shuō mǐ lātuō tā dài jù huà , qiánhòu liǎngzhāng bǎshǒu tú tā gǎi hǎo zàijì , bié ná shàngwèi suōduǎn de nà zhāng zìjǐ zuò le yígè lái guài tā .
pairs.english: Someone loudly put away shutters downstairs. Iven glanced over and passed on Mira's message: she would send both handle drawings after revising them; don't build from the unshortened version and blame her.
pairs.hanzi: 楼下有人收起门板，声音很响，伊文顺着看了一眼，说米拉托他带句话，前后两张把手图她改好再寄，别拿尚未缩短的那张自己做了一个来怪她。

pairs.target: tā shuō tā rújīn yíjù huà lǐ lián guàirén de cìxù dōu néng yùxiān pái hǎo , tǎ wéi xiào dé xiǎnxiē jiāng bǐngxiè pēn dào tā cè shàng .
pairs.english: He said she could now schedule even the order of blame within a sentence. Tavi laughed so hard he almost sprayed crumbs onto his booklet.
pairs.hanzi: 他说她如今一句话里连怪人的次序都能预先排好，塔维笑得险些将饼屑喷到他册上。

pairs.target: yèshēn qián , yīwén jiāng cèzǐ sāi huí dài lǐ , hái dé huíqù tóng shī nán hé yíbiàn yìrì de zhàn cì .
pairs.english: Before late night, Iven put his booklet away and still had to return to check tomorrow's station sequence with Shinan.
pairs.hanzi: 夜深前，伊文将册子塞回袋里，还得回去同施南核一遍翌日的站次。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi sòng tā dào jiēkǒu , zhèhuí méiyǒu shuō zài zuò yíhuìer , zhī yuē zhè jǐrì ruò dōu shōugōng zǎo biàn zǒu yìxiǎo duàn , yīwén shuōhǎo , xiān bié jiào nà yíduàn cháng dào dé zài lùbiān shuì .
pairs.english: Tavi walked him to the corner, without asking him to stay longer this time. They agreed on a short walk one of these days if both finished early. Iven agreed, provided it was not so long they had to sleep beside the road.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维送他到街口，这回没有说再坐一会儿，只约这几日若都收工早便走一小段，伊文说好，先别叫那一段长到得在路边睡。

pairs.target: liǎng rén fēnkāi shí , gāo jiàshàng de fēngdēng liàng zhe , xiàmiàn de gōnglù què gèzì wǎng bùtóng de wūmén qù . tǎ wéi kàn yīwén tí zhe bùdài zǒu yuǎn , hūrán bù juéde jiē fáng nà shàn méi guān de mén shì zài bǎ zìjǐ gé chūqù .
pairs.english: As they parted, wind lamps glowed on the towers, while roads below led to different doorways. Watching Iven leave with his bag, Tavi suddenly no longer felt the receiving office's open door was shutting him out.
pairs.hanzi: 两人分开时，高架上的风灯亮着，下面的公路却各自往不同的屋门去。塔维看伊文提着布袋走远，忽然不觉得接房那扇没关的门是在把自己隔出去。
